info.name: N3XT API Documentation Approvals AuditTrail API

params.name: actorId
params.description: Filter audit trail records by actor ID.

params.name: walletId
params.description: Filter audit trail records by wallet ID.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter audit trail records by type (business or wallet).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of audit trail records to return (optional).

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sort audit trail records by a field. Available fields: createdAt (optional).

params.name: order
params.description: Sort direction. Available values: asc, desc. (optional).

items.docs: Lists all audit trail records for the authenticated user's business matching the filter criteria.
